title: Polar Coordinates and Polar Graphs
seo_title: Polar Coordinates Worksheet: Converting Points and Equations, Polar Graphs | 100 Questions
standard_text: Represent complex numbers on the complex plane in rectangular and polar form (including real and imaginary numbers), and explain why the rectangular and polar forms of a given complex number represent the same number.
meta_desc: Free precalculus worksheet on polar coordinates: converting points and equations between polar and rectangular form, equivalent coordinates, roses, cardioids and limaçons. 100 questions.
key_big: x = r cos θ, y = r sin θ, r² = x² + y².
body_html:
How it works

  • A polar point (r, θ) is r units from the pole in the direction θ.
  • Polar to rectangular: x = r cos θ, y = r sin θ. Rectangular to polar: r = √(x² + y²), and θ from tan θ = y/x in the correct quadrant.
  • A point has many names: (r, θ) = (r, θ + 2π) = (−r, θ + π).
  • Graphs: r = a is a circle; r = a cos θ or a sin θ is a circle through the pole; r = a sin nθ is a rose with n petals (n odd) or 2n (n even); r = a + a cos θ is a cardioid.
Example

Convert (4, 2π/3) to rectangular coordinates.

x = 4 cos(2π/3) = −2

y = 4 sin(2π/3) = 2√3

Answer: (−2, 2√3)

Example

Write r = 6 cos θ in rectangular form.

Multiply by r: r² = 6r cos θ

x² + y² = 6x

Answer: a circle centered at (3, 0) with radius 3

Common mistakes

  • Swapping cos and sin: x uses cosine.
  • Using tan⁻¹(y/x) without checking the quadrant.
  • Thinking (−r, θ) is the same point as (r, θ). Use (−r, θ + π).
  • Counting n petals when n is even. There are 2n.

faq.q: How do you convert polar coordinates to rectangular?
faq.a: Use x = r cos θ and y = r sin θ.

faq.q: How do you convert rectangular coordinates to polar?
faq.a: Find r = √(x² + y²) and an angle θ with tan θ = y/x, choosing the angle in the quadrant where the point lies.

faq.q: How many petals does a polar rose have?
faq.a: r = a sin nθ or r = a cos nθ has n petals when n is odd and 2n petals when n is even.

faq.q: What does r = a cos θ look like?
faq.a: A circle of diameter a that passes through the pole, with its center on the x-axis at (a/2, 0).

items.q: How many petals does the rose r = 4 sin 3θ have?
items.e: For r = a sin nθ: n petals if n is odd, 2n petals if n is even. Here n = 3, so 3.
It is a circle of diameter 4 through the pole, to the right of the pole (cosine). r = 4 cos θ.
It is a rose with 3 petals of length 4. r = 4 cos 3θ.
It is a rose with 3 petals of length 3. r = 3 sin 3θ.
It is a rose with 3 petals of length 2. r = 2 sin 3θ.
It is a rose with 4 petals of length 2. r = 2 cos 2θ.

items.q: How many petals does the rose r = 4 cos 3θ have?
items.e: For r = a cos nθ: n petals if n is odd, 2n petals if n is even. Here n = 3, so 3.
It is a cardioid (heart shape). It points left, so the equation uses cos with a minus sign. r = 3 − 3 cos θ.

items.q: How many petals does the rose r = 3 cos 5θ have?
items.e: For r = a cos nθ: n petals if n is odd, 2n petals if n is even. Here n = 5, so 5.

items.q: How many petals does the rose r = 2 cos 3θ have?
items.e: For r = a cos nθ: n petals if n is odd, 2n petals if n is even. Here n = 3, so 3.

items.q: How many petals does the rose r = 4 sin 6θ have?
items.e: For r = a sin nθ: n petals if n is odd, 2n petals if n is even. Here n = 6, so 12.
It is a cardioid (heart shape). It points down, so the equation uses sin with a minus sign. r = 3 − 3 sin θ.
It is a rose with 3 petals of length 3. r = 3 cos 3θ.

items.q: How many petals does the rose r = 2 cos 4θ have?
items.e: For r = a cos nθ: n petals if n is odd, 2n petals if n is even. Here n = 4, so 8.
It is a limaçon with an inner loop, because |5| > |4|. The longest distance from the pole is 4 + 5 = 9. r = 4 + 5 cos θ.
It is a circle of diameter 6 through the pole, above the pole (sine). r = 6 sin θ.
It is a rose with 5 petals of length 4. r = 4 sin 5θ.
It is a limaçon with an inner loop, because |5| > |3|. The longest distance from the pole is 3 + 5 = 8. r = 3 + 5 cos θ.
It is a rose with 4 petals of length 2. r = 2 sin 2θ.

items.q: How many petals does the rose r = 4 cos 5θ have?
items.e: For r = a cos nθ: n petals if n is odd, 2n petals if n is even. Here n = 5, so 5.
